textos.24 marchas numeradas, sin platos ni piño: 24 numbered gears, no chainrings or cogs
textos.Calcula la potencia con tu cadencia, la: Calculates power from your cadence, the ratio, the weights and the terrain.
textos.Cada marcha suma o resta pendiente a la: Each gear adds or subtracts grade from Zwift's.
textos.Cada trama del rodillo, el Square y Zwif: Every frame from the trainer, the Square and Zwift as it arrives
textos.Ignora Zwift y las marchas mientras esté: Ignores Zwift and the gears while active.
textos.Mientras la app publica por Bluetooth, e: While the app publishes over Bluetooth, the phone is called “Smart Bike” to all devices (car, headphones, other phones). When it ends, it gets “OnePlus 8” back.
textos.Opcional. Si ruedas con un ventilador Wa: Optional. If you ride with a Wahoo KICKR Headwind fan, plug it in and tap “Search” to control it from the buttons.
textos.Potencia, cadencia y resistencia · por w: Power, cadence and resistance · over Wi-Fi
